title: Fix 'Runtime directory is not owned by UID' error
summary: Resolve an error where the systemd user instance fails to start because the runtime directory (/run/user/UID) has incorrect ownership. This often happens due to Docker bind mounts.

aliases.text: runtime directory not owned by uid

error_patterns: Runtime directory '/run/user/1000' is not owned by UID 1000, as it should

steps.explain: Check if Docker or another system service is mounting into /run/user/UID. If so, remove the mount from the container configuration or disable/delay the Docker service.
